# Rezonate

> Rezonate (formerly KeyReply) is an AI-powered customer engagement platform for regulated, high-volume industries: healthcare, insurance, banking, government, and sports. It delivers AI voice agents, WhatsApp automation, multi-channel chat, and governed workflow automation. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certified, a WhatsApp Global Business Solution Provider, a Microsoft Partner, and Gartner-recognized. Headquartered in Singapore, operating in the United States, Brazil, and Australia.

Rezonate's product is **Kira**, an AI customer operations platform that unifies AI voice agents, 10 messaging channels (WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, and more), visual workflow automation, a human-in-the-loop inbox, knowledge management, and compliance controls into one governed system. Kira is the product; Rezonate is the brand.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Formerly known as KeyReply; rebranded to Rezonate in 2026. Founded in Singapore.
- A decade of experience building AI engagement technology, starting in healthcare.
- Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, PDPA, LGPD presets; tenant-level data isolation; audit logs; DNC controls; PHI-aware handling.
- Healthcare: FHIR-integrated; appointment reminders, post-discharge follow-up, care navigation, prescription adherence outreach.
- Voice: real-time STT + LLM + TTS, barge-in handling, SIP carrier support, supervisor monitoring.
- Typical deployment: ~4 weeks, configuration-first (no custom code required).

Healthcare, insurance, banking and financial services, government and public sector, sports and live events.
